## Summary

[Partial] Replace a faulty 12-ohm, 20-watt power resistor in the passenger side inner fender area. [t1074]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Check the passenger side inner fender area behind the battery for a dropping resistor.
2. Remove the resistor and inspect it to see if it is open circuit.
3. [Partial] Replace the faulty 12-ohm, 20-watt power resistor with an identical unit.

_Procedure reported by [t1074]._
